name: probability-chart
title: Probability Chart
description: Liveline-powered multi-line probability chart for multi-outcome question markets (3+ outcomes). NOT for binary markets — use ProbabilityBar instead. Feed with useProbabilityHistory(questionMarkets) which returns { series }. Key props: series (OutcomeSeries[]), height? (default 220), theme? ('dark'|'light'). Each outcome is assigned a color from OUTCOME_COLORS, overridable per series.
author: Purrdict <https://purrdict.xyz>
